commit.message: docs(readme): clarify which LeJEPA parts ship
chore(git): ignore local Claude Code settings
docs(results): add TensorBoard logs of the submitted runs
docs: add third-party notices for ported code
docs(readme): rewrite as a project overview and usage guide

docs: organize research notes under docs/

Move the root-level planning, experiment and review notes into
docs/experiments, docs/proposals and docs/reviews, the game rules into
docs/mechanics and the technical reference into docs/solution.md. The
former README becomes docs/training-reference.md. Update links and code
comments that cite the old names.

Prepare the notes for public reading: write them in a neutral log voice,
redact the team ID and private notebook names, drop machine-specific paths,
and bring solution.md's league, schema and BC sections up to date.

refactor(opponents): make the agent directory configurable

Other competitors' public agents were read from hardcoded /var/tmp paths.
They now live under $KAGGRICULTURE_AGENT_DIR, defaulting to
$XDG_DATA_HOME/kaggriculture/agents, outside the checkout so frozen source
snapshots resolve the same copies. validate_submission imports the v27
path instead of duplicating it.
fix(scripts): correct project name spelling in plan submission
docs(training): document market and league pipeline
feat(league): train against screened reference agents
feat(bc): replay and stream hosted demonstrations
